name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
benefit: Interest subsidy of up to ₹1.80 Lakh on home loans up to ₹25 Lakh for eligible urban families.
eligibility: EWS/LIG/MIG families living in statutory towns without a pucca house in their name anywhere in India.
benefits: Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS) providing up to ₹1.80 Lakh interest subsidy over a 5-year tenure.
Applicable for home loans up to ₹25 Lakh on property values up to ₹35 Lakh.
Financial assistance provided for construction under Beneficiary-Led Construction (BLC) and Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP).
eligibilityCriteria: Economically Weaker Section (EWS) annual household income up to ₹3 Lakh.
Low Income Group (LIG) annual household income between ₹3 Lakh and ₹6 Lakh.
Middle Income Group (MIG) annual household income between ₹6 Lakh and ₹9 Lakh.
The beneficiary family must not own a pucca house in any part of India.
Woman ownership or co-ownership of the residential unit is required under statutory rules.

mandatory: Aadhaar cards of all household members
Income Certificate issued by the competent revenue authority / Tahsildar
Self-declaration / Affidavit confirming no pucca house ownership in India
Bank account details linked with Aadhaar and seeded with NPCI
Registered property title / agreement to sale or allotment letter
conditional: Caste / Category certificate for SC/ST/OBC beneficiaries
Disability Certificate issued by a government medical board (if applicable)

applicationProcess.description: Apply online through the PMAY-Urban 2.0 unified citizen portal or via Common Service Centres (CSCs). Applications are verified by local municipal bodies and State Level Nodal Agencies.

source.title: PMAY-Urban 2.0 Operational Guidelines
source.department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
hindiName: आयुष्मान भारत प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
department: National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
benefit: Cashless hospitalisation health cover up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year across empaneled hospitals.
eligibility: Deprivation and occupational criteria under SECC 2011; recently expanded to include all senior citizens aged 70+ irrespective of income.
benefits: Cashless and paperless access to medical services up to ₹5 Lakh per eligible family per year.
Covers secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation across 29,000+ public and private empaneled hospitals nationwide.
Pre-existing conditions are covered from day one of enrolment.
Universal coverage of ₹5 Lakh per year for all senior citizens aged 70 and above, on a family basis.
eligibilityCriteria: Households identified under rural deprivation categories (D1 to D7) or defined urban occupational categories of SECC 2011.
All Indian senior citizens aged 70 years and older (under the universal senior citizen expansion).
No cap on family size, age, or gender.

mandatory: Aadhaar card / biometric identification
Valid Ration Card or SECC beneficiary letter
conditional: Proof of age (Voter ID or Aadhaar) for senior citizen 70+ category

applicationProcess.description: Check eligibility and generate the Ayushman Card through the Beneficiary Portal (beneficiary.nha.gov.in) or by visiting any empaneled hospital or Common Service Centre (CSC).

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
benefit: Collateral-free enterprise credit up to ₹3 Lakh at 5% interest, ₹15,000 toolkit grant, and skill stipend.
eligibility: Traditional artisans and craftspeople working in 18 specified trades with hands and tools; minimum age 18.
benefits: Recognition as a Vishwakarma with an official PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID Card.
Basic skill verification (5-7 days) with a stipend of ₹500 per day during training.
Modern toolkit incentive of ₹15,000 issued via e-RUPI / digital voucher upon completion of basic skill assessment.
Collateral-free Enterprise Development Loans: First tranche up to ₹1 Lakh (18-month tenure) and second tranche up to ₹2 Lakh (30-month tenure) at a concessional interest rate of 5%.
eligibilityCriteria: An artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools in one of the 18 eligible traditional trades (carpenters, blacksmiths, goldsmiths, potters, sculptors, cobblers, tailors, etc.).
Minimum age of 18 years on the date of registration.
The beneficiary should not have availed credit under similar credit-based schemes (PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, Mudra) in the past 5 years.
Registration and benefits are restricted to one member per family.

mandatory: Aadhaar card with linked active mobile number
Bank Account passbook or cancelled cheque
Ration Card for family verification
conditional: Trade practice recommendation by Gram Panchayat or Urban Local Body

applicationProcess.description: Registration is carried out through Common Service Centres (CSCs) on the PM Vishwakarma portal followed by three-stage verification: Gram Panchayat / ULB level, District Implementation Committee, and Screening Committee.

source.title: PM Vishwakarma Operational Guidelines
source.department: Ministry of MSME, Government of India

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (DA&FW)
benefit: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year transferred into bank accounts in three equal installments of ₹2,000.
eligibility: All landholding farmer families with cultivable land parcels in their name, subject to institutional exclusions.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹6,000 per annum paid directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts.
Disbursed every four months (₹2,000 per installment) through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
eligibilityCriteria: Landholding farmer families with cultivable land registered in state land revenue records.
Mandatory completion of biometric / OTP-based e-KYC on the PM-KISAN portal.
Exclusions apply to institutional landholders, income tax payees in previous assessment year, serving or retired government employees, and constitutional post holders.

mandatory: Aadhaar Card linked with active mobile number
Official landholding proof (RoR / 7/12 extract / Khatauni)
Active bank account with NPCI Aadhaar seeding

applicationProcess.description: Self-registration through the Farmers Corner on pmkisan.gov.in, or registration via local CSC centres or revenue / agriculture officers.

source.title: PM-KISAN Scheme Guidelines
source.department: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

name: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Maharashtra
benefit: Additional annual direct benefit transfer of ₹6,000 from the Government of Maharashtra to PM-KISAN beneficiaries.
eligibility: Farmer families in Maharashtra registered and verified under PM-KISAN with active land records and e-KYC.
benefits: Additional annual direct cash support of ₹6,000 paid in three equal installments of ₹2,000 each.
Combined with central PM-KISAN, eligible Maharashtra farmers receive total annual income support of ₹12,000.
eligibilityCriteria: Must be a resident farmer of Maharashtra with cultivable landholding recorded on 7/12 & 8A land extracts.
Must be an approved and verified beneficiary under the Central PM-KISAN portal.
Bank account must be Aadhaar-seeded with active DBT enablement.

mandatory: Aadhaar Card
Maharashtra 7/12 and 8A land records extract
PM-KISAN beneficiary registration number
Aadhaar-seeded bank account

applicationProcess.description: Automatic onboarding for verified Maharashtra PM-KISAN beneficiaries. Inquiries and grievance redressal handled through the Commissionerate of Agriculture, Pune.

source.title: Government Resolution No. KISAN-2023/C.R.74/11-A
source.department: Agriculture and Farmers Welfare Department, Maharashtra

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
department: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Maharashtra
benefit: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,500 transferred directly into the bank accounts of eligible women.
eligibility: Women residents of Maharashtra aged 21 to 65 years with annual family income up to ₹2.5 Lakh.
benefits: Direct monthly cash transfer of ₹1,500 (totaling ₹18,000 per year) via Aadhaar-linked bank account.
Empowers economic self-reliance and health/nutrition support for women.
eligibilityCriteria: Permanent female resident of Maharashtra aged between 21 and 65 years.
Married, widowed, divorced, abandoned, or destitute women.
Combined annual family income must not exceed ₹2.50 Lakh.
No family member should be a regular/permanent government employee or income tax payer.
Beneficiary family should not own a four-wheeler (excluding agricultural tractor).

mandatory: Aadhaar Card of applicant
Maharashtra Domicile Certificate or Birth Certificate or School Leaving Certificate showing birth in Maharashtra
Income Certificate issued by Tahsildar (family income <= ₹2.5 Lakh) or Yellow/Orange Ration Card
Bank Passbook with Aadhaar linked & DBT active
Self-declaration undertaking adhering to scheme criteria
conditional: Divorce decree or husband death certificate (for widowed/divorced category)

applicationProcess.description: Online application through the official portal (ladakibahin.maharashtra.gov.in) or mobile app, and offline submission via Anganwadi centres, Gram Panchayat offices, or Setu Suvidha Kendras.

source.title: Government Resolution No. WCD-2024/C.R.181/K-02
source.department: Women and Child Development Department, Maharashtra

name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna
regionalName: राजर्षी छत्रपती शाहू महाराज शिक्षण शुल्क शिष्यवृत्ती योजना
hindiName: राजर्षी छत्रपती शाहू महाराज शिक्षण शुल्क शिष्यवृत्ती
department: Directorate of Higher Education / Directorate of Technical Education, Maharashtra
benefit: 50% Tuition Fee and 50% Exam Fee reimbursement for students pursuing higher and professional education.
eligibility: Maharashtra domicile students admitted via Centralized Admission Process (CAP) with family income up to ₹8 Lakh.
benefits: 50% reimbursement of tuition fees and exam fees in government-aided and private un-aided higher/technical institutes.
Covers engineering, management, pharmacy, medical, agriculture, and general degree courses.
eligibilityCriteria: Applicant must be an Indian citizen and domicile of Maharashtra.
Annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹8.00 Lakh (attested by Tahsildar).
Admission must be through Centralized Admission Process (CAP round).
Maximum two children from the same family can avail the scholarship.
Minimum 50% attendance required in the ongoing academic course.

mandatory: Domicile Certificate of Maharashtra issued by competent authority
Current Financial Year Income Certificate issued by Tahsildar
CAP Allotment Letter and admission fee receipt
Previous year passing mark sheet (SSC / HSC / Degree)
College Bonafide Certificate and Identity Card
Aadhaar-seeded bank account details
conditional: Declaration certificate of parents regarding number of children

applicationProcess.description: Apply every academic year on the MahaDBT Portal (mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in) under Directorate of Higher Education / Technical Education.

source.title: MahaDBT Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme Guidelines
source.department: Higher and Technical Education Department, Maharashtra

name: Dr. Panjabrao Deshmukh Vasatigruh Nirvah Bhatta Yojna
regionalName: डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख वसतिगृह निर्वाह भत्ता योजना
hindiName: डॉ. पंजाबराव देशमुख वसतिगृह निर्वाह भत्ता योजना
benefit: Hostel maintenance allowance up to ₹30,000/year in metropolitan areas or ₹20,000/year in other areas.
eligibility: Children of registered small/marginal farmers or agricultural laborers admitted to technical/professional degrees.
benefits: Hostel maintenance allowance of ₹30,000 for 10 months for institutes situated in MMR / Pune / Nagpur / Aurangabad municipal corporations.
Hostel allowance of ₹20,000 for 10 months for other district municipal and rural locations.
eligibilityCriteria: Student must be admitted through Centralized Admission Process (CAP) in an approved technical/professional degree or diploma course.
Child of registered Alpabhudharak (marginal/small landholder farmer) or agricultural laborer registered in Maharashtra.
Annual family income must not exceed ₹8.00 Lakh.
Student must not be a resident of a government-run free hostel.

mandatory: Alpabhudharak (Small Landholder) Certificate issued by Tahsildar, or Registered Agricultural Labour Certificate
Registered Hostel admission letter and hostel rent payment receipts
Current Financial Year Income Certificate from Tahsildar
CAP Allotment Letter
Maharashtra Domicile Certificate

applicationProcess.description: Submit online application through the MahaDBT portal under Directorate of Technical Education post-matric schemes.

source.title: Government Resolution No. TEM-2018/C.R.185/TE-4
source.department: Higher and Technical Education Department, Maharashtra

name: PM-Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
department: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
benefit: Subsidy up to ₹78,000 for rooftop solar installations up to 3 kW capacity, enabling up to 300 units of free electricity monthly.
eligibility: Residential households with a suitable rooftop and a valid grid-connected residential electricity connection.
benefits: Central Financial Assistance (CFA) subsidy of ₹30,000 for 1 kW system.
Subsidy of ₹60,000 for 2 kW system.
Subsidy of ₹78,000 for systems of 3 kW capacity and above.
Saves up to 300 electricity units monthly with surplus power exportable via net-metering.
eligibilityCriteria: The applicant must be an Indian citizen with a residential property suitable for rooftop solar panel installation.
Must have a valid residential electricity connection in their name.
The applicant must not have availed any other central subsidy for solar rooftop panels previously.

mandatory: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Latest residential electricity bill (showing consumer number & sanction load)
Proof of roof ownership / residential property documents
Bank account details (cancelled cheque / passbook copy)

applicationProcess.description: Register on the National Portal for Rooftop Solar (pmsuryaghar.gov.in), select DISCOM, obtain technical feasibility approval, install through empaneled vendors, and submit net-meter report to claim direct subsidy.

source.title: PM - Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana Scheme Directives
source.department: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
benefit: Affordable working capital credit: 1st tranche up to ₹10,000, 2nd tranche up to ₹20,000, and 3rd tranche up to ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy.
eligibility: Urban street vendors vending in urban areas on or before March 24, 2020, possessing a Certificate of Vending or LOR.
benefits: Initial working capital collateral-free loan of up to ₹10,000 repayable in 1-year monthly installments.
Enhanced tranches of ₹20,000 and ₹50,000 upon timely repayment.
Interest subsidy of 7% per annum credited quarterly on timely loan service.
Cashback of up to ₹1,200 per year on digital transactions.
eligibilityCriteria: Street vendors possessing a Certificate of Vending / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Bodies (ULBs).
Vendors identified in survey who did not receive ID card, supported by a Letter of Recommendation (LOR) from ULB / Town Vending Committee.
Vendors from surrounding peri-urban or rural areas vending in geographical limits of ULBs.

mandatory: Aadhaar Card linked to active mobile phone
Certificate of Vending / ID Card or Letter of Recommendation (LoR)
Bank Account details

applicationProcess.description: Apply through the PM SVANidhi portal (pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in) directly or through Common Service Centres (CSCs) and local Urban Local Bodies.

source.title: Scheme Guidelines for PM Street Vendor’s AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
source.department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
benefit: Collateral-free institutional loans up to ₹20 Lakh (Tarun Plus category enhanced in Budget 2024) for non-corporate micro enterprises.
eligibility: Non-farm micro and small enterprises in manufacturing, trading, and services sectors requiring business loans.
benefits: Shishu category: Loans up to ₹50,000 for early-stage ventures.
Kishore category: Loans between ₹50,000 and ₹5,00,000.
Tarun category: Loans between ₹5,00,000 and ₹10,00,000.
Tarun Plus: Loans enhanced up to ₹20,00,000 for entrepreneurs who have previously repaid Tarun loans successfully.
No collateral security or processing charges for Shishu loans.
eligibilityCriteria: Any Indian citizen having a business plan for non-farm income-generating activity.
Must not be a defaulter to any bank or financial institution.
Business must fall under manufacturing, processing, trading, or services.

mandatory: Proof of Identity (Aadhaar / Voter ID / Passport / Driving Licence)
Proof of Residence (Electricity bill / Aadhaar / Domicile)
Business address and establishment registration proof
Bank statement of past 6 months
conditional: Audited financial statements and income tax returns for loans exceeding ₹5 Lakh

applicationProcess.description: Apply through the Udyami Mitra portal (udyamimitra.in) or by visiting any commercial bank, Regional Rural Bank (RRB), or Small Finance Bank branch.

source.title: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana Guidelines & Tarun Plus Directives
source.department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development (MoWCD)
benefit: Maternity cash incentive of ₹5,000 for the first child and ₹6,000 for the second child (if girl) disbursed via DBT.
eligibility: Pregnant women and lactating mothers who are not regular employees of Central/State Government or PSUs.
benefits: Cash incentive of ₹5,000 in two installments for the first live birth upon timely registration of pregnancy and institutional birth.
Incentive of ₹6,000 in single installment for the second child, provided the child is a girl, promoting positive sex ratio.
Direct wage compensation and nutrition encouragement transferred directly to mother's bank account.
eligibilityCriteria: Pregnant Women and Lactating Mothers (PW&LM) who are at least 19 years of age at pregnancy registration.
Household belongs to socially / economically disadvantaged groups (e.g. SC/ST, BPL/EWS cardholder, Ayushman PM-JAY beneficiary, farmer family, income under ₹8 Lakh).
Excludes regular employees of Central Govt, State Govt, or Public Sector Undertakings.

mandatory: Mother and Child Protection (MCP) Card registered with Anganwadi / Health Centre
Aadhaar card of the mother with mobile link
Bank Passbook of mother (Aadhaar seeded, NPCI mapped)
Child Birth Registration Certificate
conditional: Eligibility qualification document (EWS / Ration Card / PM-JAY card)

applicationProcess.description: Apply on the PMMVY portal (pmmvy.wcd.gov.in) directly or submit physical forms at local Anganwadi Centres (AWC) or approved health facilities.

source.title: PMMVY Scheme Implementation Guidelines (Mission Shakti)
source.department: Ministry of Women and Child Development

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
hindiName: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना
department: Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD) / State Social Welfare Departments
benefit: Monthly pension of ₹200 to ₹500 (central contribution) plus state top-up (typically ₹1,000–₹1,500 total in Maharashtra) for elderly citizens in BPL families.
eligibility: Citizens aged 60 years and above belonging to households living Below Poverty Line (BPL).
benefits: Guaranteed monthly social security pension directly transferred into bank/postal accounts.
Central component of ₹200/month for age 60–79 and ₹500/month for age 80+ supplemented with state social pension grants.
eligibilityCriteria: Applicant must be 60 years of age or older.
Must belong to a household living Below the official Poverty Line according to criteria prescribed by Govt of India.

mandatory: Aadhaar Card / Voter ID for proof of age
BPL Ration Card or BPL certificate issued by Tahsildar / Block Development Officer
Bank Passbook or Post Office Savings Account passbook

applicationProcess.description: Submit application through the NSAP portal (nsap.nic.in), local Gram Panchayat, Block Development Office (BDO), or Taluka Tahsil office.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY 2.0)
department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas (MoPNG)
benefit: Deposit-free LPG connection with first refill and hotplate free of cost, plus ongoing targeted subsidy of ₹300 per 14.2 kg cylinder.
eligibility: Adult woman belonging to poor households (SC/ST, PMAY, Antyodaya, or 14-point declaration) without an existing LPG connection.
benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection including security deposit of cylinder, pressure regulator, and installation charges borne by Govt.
First LPG refill and cooking stove (hotplate) provided free of cost.
Targeted subsidy of ₹300 per refill (up to 12 refills per year) credited directly to bank account via PAHAL (DBTL).
eligibilityCriteria: Applicant must be an adult woman (minimum 18 years old).
There should not be any other LPG connection from any Oil Marketing Company (IOCL, BPCL, HPCL) in the same household.
Must belong to eligible categories: SC/ST households, PMAY (Gramin), Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY), Most Backward Classes, or rural/urban poor meeting 14-point declaration.

mandatory: Aadhaar card of the applicant woman for KYC verification
Ration card issued by State Government confirming family composition
Bank Account Passbook / IFSC code
Supplementary KYC / 14-point declaration form

applicationProcess.description: Apply online through the PMUY portal (pmuy.gov.in) or submit application form at the nearest LPG distributor (Indane, Bharatgas, or HP Gas).

source.title: Ujjwala 2.0 Guidelines and Citizen Charter
source.department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) & KVIC
benefit: Credit-linked capital subsidy up to 35% for project costs up to ₹50 Lakh (manufacturing) or ₹20 Lakh (service).
eligibility: Individuals aged 18+; minimum 8th class pass for manufacturing projects above ₹10 Lakh and service projects above ₹5 Lakh.
benefits: Margin money subsidy of 15% (General Urban), 25% (General Rural / Special Category Urban), and 35% (Special Category Rural including SC/ST/OBC/Women/Minorities).
Maximum admissible project cost is ₹50 Lakh for manufacturing sector and ₹20 Lakh for service/business sector.
eligibilityCriteria: Any individual above 18 years of age.
At least VIII standard pass for projects costing above ₹10 Lakh in manufacturing and above ₹5 Lakh in business/service sector.
Only new micro enterprises are eligible for initial assistance.

mandatory: Aadhaar Card and PAN Card
Project Report / Detailed Project Feasibility Summary (DPR)
Educational qualification certificate (minimum 8th pass certificate)
Rural area certificate from competent authority (if claiming rural subsidy)
conditional: Special category certificate (Caste / PH / Ex-Serviceman / Minority certificate)

applicationProcess.description: Apply exclusively online through the KVIC PMEGP e-Portal (kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal). Applications are vetted by District Level Task Force Committees.

source.title: PMEGP Operational Guidelines & Margin Money Norms
source.department: Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC), Ministry of MSME

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
department: Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA), Ministry of Finance
benefit: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 from age 60 based on contribution.
eligibility: All Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 years having a savings bank account; not liable to pay income tax.
benefits: Guaranteed minimum pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month upon reaching 60 years of age.
Same pension amount to the spouse upon demise of subscriber.
Return of accumulated pension corpus to nominee after demise of both subscriber and spouse.
eligibilityCriteria: Any citizen of India between 18 and 40 years of age.
Must have an active savings bank account with auto-debit facility.
Effective October 1, 2022, citizens who are or have been income tax payers are not eligible to join APY.

mandatory: Aadhaar Card
Savings bank account passbook with auto-debit consent
Active mobile number linked to bank account

applicationProcess.description: Subscribe through net banking or mobile banking apps of your bank, or visit your savings bank branch or post office branch with APY subscriber form.

source.title: Atal Pension Yojana Scheme Notification & Rules
source.department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
